Kade kaam kade log banate hain.
Grit mushkilon mein saath deti hai.
Courage aur grit repetition mein forged hote.
Jis cheez ke liye khade ho—bold raho.
Grit abhedya hai.
Courage measure hota hai jo aap karte.
Dabaav ke beech shaant aur sthir rehna hi asli himmat hai.
Fear itna hi deep jitna mind allow karta.
Grit arena mein rehna hai.
Grit andar ki shakti hai.
Har experience se strength, courage, confidence banta hai—jab tum fear ko face karte ho.
Grit gehri hai.
Himmat chingari hai.
Khamoshi ek panah hai.
Jab chhodna ho, tab bhi chalte raho.
Apni yojnaon ko raat jaisi dark aur impenetrable rakho, aur jab move karo to bijli ki tarah girna.
Grit mein sabr chahiye.
Himmat matlab phir bhi karna.
Khamoshi pavitra hai.
Zarurat ho to bolo.
Grit ichha hai.
